_structure_mode_doc: Active mode — one of the keys under "modes". Override at runtime with --structure-mode.
_max_correction_rounds_doc: hard cap on VLM correction rounds; on cap the least-violating round is kept
_image_size_doc: Gemini image output tier: 1K|2K|4K. 2K (2752x1536 @16:9) is ~2x linear resolution of 1K, so small rooms/doors/walls land above the CV trace/parse thresholds. Env HFAGENT_IMAGE_SIZE overrides. NOTE: for boundary (image-to-image) the model may ignore this and return ~1K.
_image_aspect_doc: Gemini image aspect ratio for pure text-to-image. With a boundary/reference image the output aspect follows that image automatically (llm.py _first_image_aspect). Env HFAGENT_IMAGE_ASPECT overrides.

colorblock.description: Two-pass: text -> realistic architectural plan -> AI flat colour-block -> cv_parse. Legacy fallback; image models leak text / draw door-arc spikes.

json.description: text -> realistic plan -> VLM reads it into a 32x18 grid-cell JSON (rooms as cells + doors) -> rectify into an orthogonal Plan.

linework.description: text -> realistic LINE drawing -> tools/linework_tracer: faithful wall trace, doors confirmed only by their swing arcs, rooms polygonized UNTYPED (geometry-only, no OCR). Single round; fixed artifacts walls_overlay/doors_overlay/recon/recon_post/rooms_colorful.

direct_colorblock.description: One-pass: text -> flat colour-block directly (no realistic plan) -> cv_parse; doors from program adjacency. Cleaner geometry, ~half the cost; best <= ~33 rooms.

_models_doc: Per mode: text_model / image_model are Gemini ids; empty = auto-resolve newest (llm.py preference). Env HFAGENT_TEXT_MODEL / HFAGENT_IMAGE_MODEL override.
_boundary_doc: Per mode: path to a building-outline PNG (relative to hfagent/ or absolute); empty = no boundary. --boundary flag / per-program "boundary" field override at runtime. Boundary only affects pass-1 (see docs/boundary-pipeline-audit.md).
